notes: Current code generates images with SenseNova, Krea, SimpleDiffusion and Un-0, and video with Wan, LiveEdit and Un-0 through their active recipes. The tests below establish only their stated shapes and comparisons. SenseNova has an unresolved exact-output regression, so current image/video validation is incomplete.

This checkpoint fixes shared GIF timing and the report reader's rejection of valid external JSON-array oracle files. The [cost profile](docs/image_video_costs.json) maps all seven active model/task pairs, common owners, memory lifetimes and CPU/GPU transfers. Its byte estimates are predictions, not measured optimization gains.

Remaining work includes resolving the SenseNova exact-output mismatch, fresh full-length Wan generation and visual/temporal review, complete frozen-case coverage, public workflow and cancellation checks, and matched speed/memory/transfer comparisons. The operator requested a stop after this checkpoint commit; these obligations remain open in the plan.

The GIF checks were repeated after converting the test loop to Go's integer-range syntax. The earlier passing acquisition remains stored as evidence:sha256:436bf59f286ab85b48abb5aa7c3d13b37a6198ab2e6f2e634c17a6fd488e31de; the table cites the final test source.
